title: Uruguayan Pumpkin Empanadas
description: A delicious twist on traditional empanadas, filled with roasted pumpkin and spices, perfect for a cozy dinner.
instructions: Caramelize the onion in a pan for 10 minutes.
Add the garlic, cumin, paprika, and salt to the pan and cook for 1 minute.
Add the diced pumpkin to the pan and cook for 5 minutes.
Roll out the empanada dough to a thickness of 1/8 inch.
Place a tablespoon of the pumpkin mixture onto one half of the dough circle.
Fold the dough in half and press the edges to seal.
Brush the tops with a little water and bake for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown.
